title: Chacha Chale Aao
body:
1. Sakina (sa) Kahti Hai Ro Kar Chacha (as) Chale Aao
Tumhein (as) Bulati Hai Muztar (sa) Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jala Rahe Hain Sitamgar Hamare Khaimon Ko
Saron Se Chhinti Hai Chaadar Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Zaeef Baap Se Laash-e-Jawan Nahin Utthti
Bara-e-Nusrat-e-Sarwar (as) Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ghire Hain Nargha-e-Aada Me Baba (as) Jaan Mere
Bacha Lo Baba Ko Aa kar, Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bade Hi Pyaar Se Baba Ne Jo Pinhaye The
Wo Chheene Jaate Hain Gauhar Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bacha Lo Zulm Ke Panjon Se Apni Beti (sa) Ko
Tamache Lagte Hain Rukh Par Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Yateema Dhoondne Nikli Hai Baap (as) Ka Seena
Batane Laasha-e-Be Sar (as) Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Jala Hai Kurte Ka Daaman, Lavein Bhi Zakhmi Hain
Aye Mere Monis-o-Yawar Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Bandhi hai Pusht-e-Jamal se Tumhari Lakhte Jigar
Ay Jaane Fatahe Khaibar, Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Phuphi (sa) Ke Baazu Bandhe Hain, Gala Bandha Hai Mera
Hai Saans Lena Bhi Doobhar Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Sitam ki Qaid se Lillah Ab Chhuda Lo Mujhe
Ke Meri Jaan Hai Labon Par Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Nahin Hai Baba (as) Ka Seena Na Aapki Aaghosh
Sukoon Paaon Main (sa) Kyunkar Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Har Aan Dil Ko Rulati Hai Yaad Asghar (as) Ki
Use Bhi Sath Me Le Kar Chacha (as) Chale Aao
<<DIVIDER>>
14. Koi Ajab Nahin Gul Kazmi Ke Zindaan Se
Sadayen Aati Hon Aksar Chacha Chale Aao
